method: Independent manual reading of all 120 new recipe sequences, ingredients and tokens, split quantity allocation, portion-dependent shapes/counts, explicit timing, doneness checkpoints, allergens, source-scope metadata and user-facing copy. Static review only; completion indicates review coverage, not kitchen validation or approval of unresolved issues.

issues.name: 无锡酱排骨
issues.evidence: Scallion was prepared and later removed, but never inserted into the pot.
issues.resolution: Step 5 now explicitly puts the scallion knot into the pot.

issues.name: 红烧狮子头
issues.evidence: At least 535g filling was described as four 110g meatballs, leaving material unallocated.
issues.resolution: Each meatball is now 130-140g, with a fixed diameter and the number adjusted to portions.

issues.name: 苏式酱汁豆干
issues.evidence: A fixed reduced soy-sauce amount of 10ml exceeded the 7.5ml amount for one serving.
issues.resolution: The instruction now reduces the current ingredient-table quantity proportionally.

issues.name: 盐水鸭
issues.evidence: The cold-serving tip simultaneously required thorough reheating.
issues.resolution: The instruction now specifically concerns leftover portions and reheating them next time.

issues.name: 虾米芦蒿
issues.evidence: A spring-onion broad-bean reference was incorrectly marked as the direct shrimp/artemisia recipe source.
issues.resolution: The reference now concerns artemisia with dried shrimp and is honestly marked as technique support.

issues.name: 扬州炒饭
issues.evidence: The user-facing phrase about not hiding the wait described an editorial process.
issues.resolution: Only the practical extra rice-cooking time remains.

issues.name: 小炒黄牛肉
issues.evidence: Listed sugar (2g for two servings) has no addition/use in any step.
issues.recommendation: Add the sugar token during the final seasoning step.
issues.resolution: Unused sugar has been removed from A13 ingredients; all remaining seasonings have a destination.

issues.name: 嘉兴鲜肉粽
issues.evidence: The instructions fix four rice portions and four zongzi despite scaling from one to six portions. The 180g pork is cut into 3cm cubes, yet each zongzi receives only one cube without allocating all meat.
issues.recommendation: Fix each zongzi size, adjust count with portions, and divide all rice and pork among that count.
issues.resolution: Each zongzi now receives the rice corresponding to 55g dry rice and about 45g meat; count varies with total quantity and all rice/meat is allocated.

issues.name: 雪菜笋丝炒毛豆
issues.evidence: Packaged pickled mustard is tasted before cooking without restricting this to a ready-to-eat product.
issues.recommendation: Remove the pre-cooking taste, or explicitly permit it only if the package states ready-to-eat; retain tasting after cooking.
issues.resolution: The pre-cooking taste has been removed; package-directed washing and tasting only after cooking remain.

issues.name: 蒜泥白肉
issues.evidence: The boil/simmer/cool stages consume 48-55 minutes, before ingredient preparation and final slicing, while total is 60 minutes.
issues.recommendation: Use about 70-75 minutes or document the preparation overlap that supports the shorter estimate.
issues.resolution: A03 total estimate is now 75 minutes.

issues.name: 鲁式酥焖带鱼
issues.evidence: The stated 80-minute total is below preparation 20 + frying 8 + pressure rise 20 + pressure cooking 20 + release 20 = 88 minutes; batch frying increases it further.
issues.recommendation: Set about 100 minutes and retain the device-dependent rise/release note.
issues.resolution: A25 total estimate is now 100 minutes, with device-dependent pressure rise/release guidance retained.

issues.name: 闽南咸饭
issues.evidence: The check fixes 230ml water / 180g rice while the ingredient table scales these values with portions.
issues.recommendation: Refer to the current ingredient-table starting amount and the cooker/rice-type guide without fixed numbers.
issues.resolution: The check now refers to current ingredient-table water/rice amounts and cooker guides instead of fixed 230ml/180g numbers.

issues.name: 闽南花生汤
issues.evidence: The final instruction always divides into two bowls despite a variable portion count.
issues.recommendation: Divide into bowls according to the selected portions.
issues.resolution: The soup is now divided into bowls according to current portions.

issues.name: 闽南蛤蜊蒸丝瓜
issues.evidence: The tip explains cuisine browsing classification and non-exclusive provenance instead of helping cook the dish.
issues.recommendation: Remove it from user tips; preserve source scope only in internal documentation.
issues.resolution: The cuisine-browsing provenance tip has been removed.

issues.name: 闽南蛤蜊蒸丝瓜
issues.evidence: access is ingredients-only and the note says complete method cannot be read, yet support is technique.
issues.recommendation: Classify it as ingredient-combination support rather than evidence for the complete steaming method.
issues.resolution: The public ingredient-only reference is now marked support=ingredients; heating safety retains its separate technique reference.

issues.name: Shared recipe detail timing label
issues.evidence: Every prepMinutes value is displayed as marinating/proofing, although new recipes such as plain winter melon only use active preparation.
issues.recommendation: Use a neutral preparation/waiting label unless a more specific timing type is provided.
issues.resolution: recipeBody now uses a neutral preparation/waiting label.

issues.name: 徽州蒸蛋饺
issues.evidence: Three eggs provide roughly 150ml, enough for 10-12 skins at 12-15ml each; about 230g filling at 12g each requires about 19 skins.
issues.recommendation: Coordinate egg quantity, per-skin egg volume and filling weight so the full filling is used, keeping filling thickness at most 1cm.
issues.resolution: The recipe now uses four eggs and about 12ml per skin with about 14g filling, allocating the full mixture while preserving the 1cm thickness limit.

issues.name: 蕨菜炒腊肉
issues.evidence: The tip describes classification in Anhui cuisine browsing and non-exclusive origin instead of a cooking action.
issues.recommendation: Remove the classification editorial text from tips.
issues.resolution: The internal Anhui cuisine-classification tip has been removed.

issues.name: 黄山炖鸽
issues.evidence: The phrase about not making efficacy promises describes editorial policy rather than cooking guidance.
issues.recommendation: Keep practical ingredient/equipment guidance only.
issues.resolution: The efficacy-promise policy sentence has been replaced by practical yam timing and pot-water checks.

issues.name: 宁夏羊肉萝卜汤
issues.evidence: The tip describes browsing as northwestern lamb-soup flavor, an internal classification story.
issues.recommendation: Keep only the practical 3cm-meat slow-simmer advice.
issues.resolution: The northwestern cuisine-browsing phrase has been removed.

issues.name: 酸菜白肉
issues.evidence: The listed boneless pork belly receives a generic instruction to pick out small bones.
issues.recommendation: Replace the irrelevant bone boilerplate with a concrete hot-soup/serving check.
issues.resolution: The boneless pork instruction now mentions hot soup and serving rather than bone picking.

issues.name: 虾酱炒鸡蛋
issues.evidence: The phrase saying not to accompany with a whole shrimp repeats an internal image-correction instruction, unrelated to this ingredient list.
issues.recommendation: Keep the final doneness/serving check and omit the image-editing contrast.
issues.resolution: The final check now only confirms cooked egg and warm serving, without the whole-shrimp contrast.

issues.name: 天津卷圈
issues.evidence: The phrase saying not to make a doughnut ring repeats an internal correction to the illustration brief.
issues.recommendation: Describe the cylindrical roll/cutting action directly without the unrelated doughnut contrast.
issues.resolution: The final check now describes the cylindrical roll cross-section with cooked vegetable filling.

issues.name: 北京芥末墩
issues.evidence: The dish contains 8g mustard powder and is described as pungent, but spicy=false lets it through the do-not-eat-spicy filter.
issues.recommendation: Mark the dish spicy based on the strong mustard sensation, preserving the actual user-facing no-spicy meaning.
issues.resolution: A44 is now spicy=true.

issues.name: 菠菜鸡蛋水晶蒸饺
issues.evidence: The water-crystal dough lists 100g chengfen, normally wheat starch, but the allergens only listed egg.
issues.recommendation: Add wheat and direct users to the powder package.
issues.resolution: B51 now lists wheat and egg and explains checking the chengfen packaging.

issues.name: 香蕉核桃烤松糕
issues.evidence: The 55-minute estimate omitted the wait for refrigerated butter to soften at room temperature.
issues.recommendation: Account for softening or state an explicit pre-softened ingredient condition.
issues.resolution: B53 now explicitly waits 30-60 minutes for butter to soften, prepMinutes=60 and total minutes=115; colder conditions may extend the wait.

issues.name: 豆沙山药卷
issues.evidence: Both source notes state these are separate yam-mash / bean-paste shaping techniques, not the full yam-roll recipe, yet support=recipe.
issues.recommendation: Mark both as technique rather than direct full-recipe support.
issues.resolution: Both A52 technique-combination sources are now support=technique, matching their notes.

issues.name: 杂粮煎饼
issues.evidence: The Guoba-cai source note says it only supports grain batter / thin pancake technique, but support=recipe for the different breakfast.
issues.recommendation: Mark the source as technique.
issues.resolution: The A57 Guoba-cai source is now support=technique, matching its limited batter/pancake scope.

issues.name: 土豆鸡蛋沙拉
issues.evidence: The source note says only the public video ingredient description was read, not the full tutorial, yet support=technique.
issues.recommendation: Mark as ingredients; do not imply direct method verification.
issues.resolution: The A60 public video description is now support=ingredients, with separate food-safety technique support instead of an implied full-video recipe check.

issues.name: 绿豆糕（去皮绿豆版）
issues.evidence: The contrast with a fluffy steamed cake mirrors internal image-brief corrections.
issues.recommendation: Keep the concrete dense-mung-bean-cake shape and mold-free shaping advice.
issues.resolution: The A54 tip now directly describes the dense mung-bean cake and mold-free shaping option.

issues.name: 藜麦蔬菜蛋盅
issues.evidence: The sentence saying fine grains cannot replace staple portions is semantically unclear and provides no concrete basis for the nutrition judgment.
issues.recommendation: Keep the practical advice to pre-cook quinoa before adding it to eggs.
issues.resolution: The A58 tip now only explains pre-cooking quinoa and keeping the egg cup shallow.

checks.splitAmounts: All 120 sequences were manually read. Every explicit fractional-token series sums to one after A46 was made explicit for all three protein bowls. Prepared full tokens were not falsely counted as repeated additions.
checks.scaling: Current CookCore.scale and stepText were executed on all 120 recipes at 1, 2 and 6 portions: 4 fixed-scaling ingredients kept the pot quantity; 1170 recipe-text tokens rendered without unresolved braces, undefined or NaN.
checks.ingredientFlow: All 120 positive-quantity ingredient lists and sequences were read. The reported A13 sugar, B17 zongzi allocation and B34 egg-skin/filling mismatch were corrected and reread.
checks.sources: Source support was checked against attached scope/access notes. A52/A57 were downgraded to techniques and A60/B29 to ingredient support where appropriate. Original web pages were read by the content authors; this independent reviewer did not re-fetch every source. B31 naming was separately checked by the root against Huangshan government material.
checks.validationBoundary: No kitchen test, no tasting, no physical device validation; timer totals are approximate wall-clock estimates, not proofs of doneness.
checks.allergens: All 120 primary-ingredient allergen lists were read. B51 wheat omission was corrected. Brand-specific sauce, cured-meat and prepared-food additives still require package checking.
checks.timing: All 120 waiting/heating sequences were read. A03/A25 and B53 estimates were corrected; fermentation, soaking, refrigeration and batch size limits remain explicit. These are approximate time estimates, not proofs of food safety.
checks.categories: Root classified sweet/small breakfast dishes A20/A49/A50/B17/B30 as breakfast with cuisine=null, preserving regional discovery aliases; A44 mustard is treated as spicy.

reviewQuestions.question: Whether the unmodified regional name should explicitly identify the household steaming variant because the source technique uses a special wooden board.
reviewQuestions.note: Not asserted as a factual defect without independent primary-source verification.
reviewQuestions.resolution: Root read the Huangshan government description: modern preparation is steaming/cutting/restreaming without a required camphor board. Name retained; obsolete exclusive aroma claim to be removed.
